$comment: The Lane-A engine pin — the EXACT published bce-engine version that gates this tree independently of the code under review. See docs/pin-ceremony.md and docs/self-hosting.md §'Lane A / Lane B'. Bumping this pin is a PR gated by the OLD pin (a trust-anchor ratchet), never an in-line edit.
rangeRationale: EXACT pin only — never ^0.6.3, ~0.6.3, or @latest. Lane A must be independent of the code under review, so it installs a fixed published artifact. A range would let a later publish silently change the grader every contributor is measured against, reintroducing the trusting-trust hole Lane A exists to close. The caret-0.x incident is the recorded reason: on a 0.x line `^0.6.3` is equivalent to `~0.6.3` and EXCLUDES 0.7.0, so a caret pin does not even receive a minor bump — it ships dead-green.
publishedNote: bce-engine@0.6.3 is live on the public npm registry with verified SLSA provenance from release run 42723194499 attempt 1; its exact registry integrity, source commit, and six-asset immutable Release are recorded above. Fresh registry consumers passed all 52 route cases and all 90 declared-stack cases against those same bytes.
trustAnchor: Lane A installs the exact public bce-engine@0.6.3 artifact, independently of the code under review. This pin is admitted by the predecessor v0.6.2 pin from the activation PR base.
